title: Lisa Possible NDE 4061
content: I was in hospital due to Anorexia Nervosa. I woke up suddenly at like 3:00 am. I was looking down at my body and aware of a presence sort of to my right and behind me. I realized (not really visual, but could somehow see him?) that Jesus was there. It surprised me, as I was agnostic. We began a communication/transmission. As if we didn't speak, yet I could hear his voice somehow. It was very brief and to the point. Firstly, I was not scared, just really surprised. I initiated the dialogue. We spoke without speaking. It's hard to describe. He was up sort of above and behind me to the right. I 'saw' him without looking/seeing him. Here's how it went: Me: 'What are YOU doing here?' (I knew he was put off by this and felt things hadn't started out too well, he seemed in a rush, impatient once I 'transmitted' this to him.) Him: 'Do you want to stay or go?' Me: 'STAY.' Him: 'Okay, you have to make a promise.' Me: Okay, what?' Him: ' You can never do this again.' Me: 'Okay.' Then he was not there anymore and I was back in my body, I was lying in the bed. I got up, (before this, I was unable to walk). I walked to the nurse's station and demanded food, of the highest calorie sort. I never looked back and was on a mission to gain the weight needed to get out of hospital, go home to my former life. And I did.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Jesus was perceived as a presence to her right and behind; she could 'see him' without looking/seeing him.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Choice framed as 'stay or go'; return followed after she chose 'STAY' and promised 'You can never do this again.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Encounter/communication with Jesus; promise: 'You can never do this again.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred in hospital room; immediate encounter/communication with Jesus; choice ('stay or go') and promise; then immediate return to body.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: She was out of body looking down while simultaneously aware of Jesus' presence and communicating.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Jesus perceived without normal visual seeing ('not really visual, but could somehow see him'); brief negotiation/promise ('You can never do this again'); immediate physical recovery (walked though previously unable).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was looking down at my body and aware of a presence sort of to my right and behind me.” “Do you want to stay or go?” “STAY.” “Okay, you have to make a promise… You can never do this again.”
